learn.title: The angles always add to 180
learn.body: The three angles of any triangle add up to $180^\circ$. This is one of the most used facts in geometry. It holds for every triangle, big or small, thin or fat.

learn.title: Why it works
learn.body: Draw a line through one vertex parallel to the opposite side. The two angles that form a straight line with the triangle angle are alternate interior angles with the other two. So the three angles together make a straight angle, $180^\circ$.

learn.title: Exterior angles
learn.body: Extend one side of a triangle. The angle outside the triangle, next to an interior angle, is an exterior angle. It equals the sum of the two interior angles that are not next to it (the remote ones).

learn.title: Find missing angles
learn.body: Use the angle sum and the exterior angle rule.
steps: Angles in the ratio $1:2:3$: $x+2x+3x=180$, so $x=30$. Angles: $30,60,90$.
An exterior angle is $120^\circ$ and one remote angle is $45^\circ$.

learn.body: The exterior angle also equals $180^\circ$ minus its interior neighbour. That is the same rule as the angle sum, seen another way.

questions.prompt: A triangle has angles $50^\circ$ and $60^\circ$. Find the third angle in degrees.
A right triangle has one acute angle of $35^\circ$. Find the other acute angle in degrees.
questions.explanation: $180-90-35=55$. The two acute angles of a right triangle always add to $90^\circ$.

questions.prompt: A triangle's angles are $x$, $2x$ and $3x$. What is the largest angle?
questions.explanation: $6x=180$ gives $x=30$, so the angles are $30,60,90$ and the largest is $90^\circ$.

questions.prompt: An exterior angle of a triangle is $110^\circ$. One remote interior angle is $40^\circ$. Find the other remote interior angle in degrees.
questions.explanation: The exterior angle equals the sum of the remote angles: $110-40=70$.

questions.prompt: An exterior angle equals the sum of the two \_\_ interior angles.
questions.explanation: Remote means not next to the exterior angle.

questions.prompt: Can a triangle have angles $90^\circ$, $60^\circ$ and $50^\circ$?
choices: Yes, it is a right triangle
No, a triangle has no right angle
questions.explanation: The three angles of a triangle must add to exactly $180^\circ$.

questions.prompt: Two angles of a triangle are $x$ and $x+10$ and the third is $70^\circ$. Find $x$.
